ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a transition-state-like structure; Br is labeled on the left and is connected to the central P; the center is written as PPh3, indicating phosphorus connected to three phenyl groups; there is a positive sign near P. At the lower right there is a CBr3 fragment bearing a negative sign. There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: According to the problem and the method draft, expand PPh3 into three benzene rings connected to P. Each benzene ring internally has 6 non-hydrogen bonds, and the three benzene rings have a total of 3 × 6 = 18 benzene-ring internal bonds. The three phenyl groups are respectively connected to P, adding 3 P–phenyl bonds. In the figure, 1 Br–P bond is visible between Br and P. In the CBr3 fragment, carbon is connected to three bromines, adding 3 C–Br bonds. Ignore all hydrogen-related bonds and curved arrows. Therefore the total number of bonds is 18 + 3 + 1 + 3 = 25.

method.method_draft: Expand PPh3 into three phenyl rings attached to P. Count phenyl internal bonds: 3 × 6 = 18. Count the three P–phenyl bonds: +3. Count the visible Br–P bond: +1. Count the CBr3 fragment bonds: +3 C–Br. Ignore the curved arrows and all hydrogens. Sum 18 + 3 + 1 + 3 = 25.

推理：按照题目和方法草稿，将 PPh3 展开为三个连接在 P 上的苯环。每个苯环内部有 6 个非氢键，三个苯环共有 3 × 6 = 18 个苯环内部键。三个苯基分别与 P 相连，增加 3 个 P–苯基键。图中可见 Br 与 P 之间有 1 个 Br–P 键。CBr3 片段中碳与三个溴相连，增加 3 个 C–Br 键。忽略所有氢相关键和弯曲箭头。因此总键数为 18 + 3 + 1 + 3 = 25。
